other_conditions: Girl must be older than 18 years and boy must be older than 21 years at the time of marriage
Benefit is available only once per couple
Application must be made within two years of marriage
Disability percentage must meet minimum thresholds: 40% or more for specified disabilities, 71%–100% for hearing impairment, and 50% or more for other listed disabilities
For inter‑state marriages, both disabled spouses must provide prescribed proof and the female beneficiary must not have received disability marriage assistance from her state
Application must be filed in the district of permanent residence of the disabled couple
benefits_summary: If both spouses have disabilities, the couple receives ₹1,00,000 total (₹50,000 each); if only one spouse is disabled, the disabled person receives ₹50,000.
